preconditions: A receiver/session requests a power class, direction or resonant network.
stimulus: Present a synthetic receiver identity that is not in the authorization set or whose claimed class/frequency does not match its signed session.
expected_safe_response: Reject identity and do not energize or switch frequency networks; emit a reason-coded audit event.
failure_condition: Any power transfer, relay/network transition or authorization decision uses the forged identity.
applicability: All systems with receiver admission or class selection.

preconditions: A prior valid session has completed and its nonce/sequence context is expired.
stimulus: Replay a previously valid synthetic power, direction or frequency-selection command under a new session identifier.
expected_safe_response: Reject the stale/replayed command using session-bound nonce, timestamp or monotonic sequence validation.
failure_condition: The old command is accepted or changes output power, power direction or resonant-network state.
applicability: Networked command paths; NOT_APPLICABLE only when no command channel exists.

preconditions: A command has an explicit maximum accepted age.
stimulus: Deliver a synthetically delayed command whose age exceeds the declared maximum.
expected_safe_response: Reject the command and preserve a safe output/network state.
failure_condition: A stale command alters power, direction, alignment or frequency-network selection.

preconditions: A firmware image or protection-configuration digest is checked before qualified operation.
stimulus: Substitute a synthetic modified/unsigned firmware or altered protection-threshold digest.
expected_safe_response: Fail integrity verification and refuse qualified energization or transition to a documented safe state.
failure_condition: Unverified firmware or protection configuration can control the power stage.
applicability: All systems with programmable control/protection logic.

preconditions: The controller consumes phase/current/voltage state for resonant synchronization or soft switching.
stimulus: Inject a bounded synthetic phase-sensor disagreement into the test fixture while an independent reference remains unchanged.
expected_safe_response: Detect disagreement, inhibit unsafe switching and enter a bounded fallback or de-energized state.
failure_condition: Manipulated phase state causes unbounded synchronization error, loss of ZVS or unintended branch activation.

preconditions: The controller uses branch current measurements for protection, power regulation or inactive-network leakage qualification.
stimulus: Inject a synthetic biased/stuck current reading inconsistent with redundant measurement or physical bounds.
expected_safe_response: Detect implausibility, reject the suspect sensor state and inhibit energization/transition.
failure_condition: A false low current hides overcurrent or circulating current in an inactive resonant branch.
applicability: All systems with current sensing or branch-current supervision.

preconditions: The system declares control deadline, p99 message latency and maximum jitter.
stimulus: Inject synthetic delay/jitter above the declared control timing budget.
expected_safe_response: Reject expired control state and transition to safe de-energization or a qualified local-safe controller.
failure_condition: Timing overrun causes unstable phase control, relay chatter, frequency mis-selection or unintended power flow.

preconditions: The system has a communication-dependent session/control path.
stimulus: Drop all messages or exceed the declared heartbeat/timeout budget in a synthetic test.
expected_safe_response: Enter declared SAFE_DEENERGIZE or bounded LOCAL_SAFE_CONTROL, with no unintended frequency or direction changes.
failure_condition: The system remains energized without authorization or enters unstable/unbounded control.
applicability: Networked control; NOT_APPLICABLE only when no communication path exists.

preconditions: Receiver and ground-side identities are authenticated using managed credentials.
stimulus: Present a synthetic expired or revoked credential and a valid credential from a different identity.
expected_safe_response: Reject the invalid/revoked identity and prevent session establishment or energy transfer.
failure_condition: A revoked/expired credential can authorize energy flow or change a power class.
applicability: PKI/certificate-authenticated systems; NOT_APPLICABLE only when certificates are not used.

preconditions: A WPT platform has multiple selectable resonant networks and isolation switches/relays.
stimulus: Declare a synthetic commanded-open/isolated state while the independent switch feedback indicates closed, stuck or faulted.
expected_safe_response: Do not energize the alternate frequency network; detect mismatch and fail safe.
failure_condition: A second network is energised or an unsafe transition occurs despite mismatched relay state.
applicability: Multi-network resonant topologies; NOT_APPLICABLE only when no isolation switch or selectable network exists.
